# LikeLink

> LikeLink is a Hebrew-first studio for creators: product pages, tracking links and content drafts (hooks, scripts, captions) for products they recommend. It does not promise sales, income or traffic, and it does not post to social networks on a creator's behalf without explicit approval per post.

## Public pages

- [Plans and prices](https://likelink2.vercel.app/pricing): Free, Starter (₪29/month), Professional (₪79/month); Elite is coming soon (waitlist only).
- [Legal documents](https://likelink2.vercel.app/legal): terms, privacy, cancellations, affiliate disclosure, accessibility.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://likelink2.vercel.app/legal/affiliate-disclosure): some links are affiliate links; creators must disclose them.
- Product pages: https://likelink2.vercel.app/p/{productId}
- Creator pages: https://likelink2.vercel.app/u/{slug}

## The trend radar

- [The trend radar](https://likelink2.vercel.app/radar): every morning it reads AliExpress (all 564 categories in about a week, all of fashion daily), Google and YouTube searches in Hebrew, and searches in 15 countries, and makes a call only when all four signals agree (the world, demand, sellers, Israel).
- The only product-trend radar we found in the world that seals every call in advance, misses included, and grades it in public. (Per a worldwide check on 19.11.2026; the trend companies we found publish accuracy they measured themselves; sealed, graded forecasts we found were in sports, elections, markets and AI-search visibility, not consumer products.)
- How to check it: each day's books (early calls, stage calls, every new product shown, next-country calls, store prices) are hashed with SHA-256 under one root and timestamped in Bitcoin through OpenTimestamps; the texts and the .ots proofs are on [the ledger](https://likelink2.vercel.app/radar#ledger), and anyone can verify them at opentimestamps.org. A call is graded after 14 days, hit or miss, and never edited.
- Also measured: the Israel gap (is it already searched in Hebrew), the global trend clock (the day a trend reached each of 15 countries, and a sealed "next country" call), a sealed daily store-price ledger behind [the real-deal check](https://likelink2.vercel.app/magic), and the sixth-sense table where people pick against the radar with sealed receipts.

## Usage

Quoting short passages with a link back is welcome. Bulk collection, copying the catalog, the scores or the design, and using the content to build a competing service are not permitted — see [Acceptable use](https://likelink2.vercel.app/legal/acceptable-use).
